how_to_apply: Download the application form (Annexure-1) from the official notification.
Fill in every item: personal details, category, addresses, qualifications from Matriculation onwards, experience, registration details and ex-employee status, then sign it.
Reach the HRDC Building, Salem Steel Plant on 20 November 2026 and register between 08.00 AM and 11.00 AM.
Submit the filled form with the documents below at the walk-in interview, held from 11.00 AM to 4.00 PM. No other mode of application will be accepted.
Carry these in original, with one set of self-attested photocopies (the Annexure-1 declaration mentions three sets of photocopies, so carrying extra copies is safer):
Proof of date of birth - SSLC/Matriculation certificate
All educational certificates and mark sheets from class X onwards
Valid registration certificate issued by MCI, National Medical Council or any State Medical Council
Photo identity proof (Voter ID, PAN Card, Aadhaar card, Driving Licence or Passport)
Recommendation letter from the Head of Medical, and self-certificate on voluntary retirement (ex-employees only)
Two recent passport size colour photographs
No TA/DA is paid for attending the walk-in interview. Information found false at any stage leads to rejection. For queries, the contact person is Shri Debariki Suresh, AGM (HR), phone 0427-2382274.

content_sections.heading: About SAIL Salem Steel Plant
content_sections.text: Steel Authority of India Limited is a Government of India enterprise, and Salem Steel Plant (SSP) is its plant at Salem. The plant runs a 40 bedded main hospital and an Occupational Health Service Center (OHSC), where this doctor will be engaged.

content_sections.heading: SAIL Salem Steel Plant GDMO Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: Experience is not mandatory. Candidates having relevant work experience shall be given preference. Ex-employees of SAIL and non-SAIL ex-employees can also apply, provided they did not separate by opting for voluntary retirement. They must bring a recommendation letter signed by the Head of Medical of their respective plant or unit, and a self-certificate that they did not separate under voluntary retirement. For the full eligibility conditions of the post, see the official notification.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Screening of documents and caste certificate. Walk-in interview before an Interview Board constituted by SSP, whose decision is final and binding. A screening test, if required. Medical screening of the selected candidate to ascertain medical fitness, which must be cleared before joining.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: Place of work: Salem Steel Plant's main hospital / Occupational Health Service Center (OHSC), Salem. Initial tenure is one year, which can be extended by one year at the Company's discretion. Engagement under the same contract cannot exceed three years. Working hours are a minimum of 8 hours a day for six days a week, or 48 hours a week. The doctor must also serve in emergent conditions or beyond normal hours, with no claim for extra pay. Performance is reviewed every year by the Head of Medical, Salem Steel Plant; the tenure can be curtailed or extended depending on performance. Either side can end the engagement with one month's notice. Poor performance or absence without permission can lead to termination. The company can also terminate forthwith for prolonged medical unfitness, moral turpitude, conviction, insolvency, loss of licence to practise, misconduct or financial irregularity. The engagement is purely contractual and gives no right to regular appointment in Salem Steel Plant. All company assets must be used properly and returned at the end of the contract.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for SAIL Salem Steel Plant GDMO Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Download the application form (Annexure-1) from the official notification. Fill in every item: personal details, category, addresses, qualifications from Matriculation onwards, experience, registration details and ex-employee status, then sign it. Reach the HRDC Building, Salem Steel Plant on 20 November 2026 and register between 08.00 AM and 11.00 AM. Submit the filled form with the documents below at the walk-in interview, held from 11.00 AM to 4.00 PM. No other mode of application will be accepted. Carry these in original, with one set of self-attested photocopies (the Annexure-1 declaration mentions three sets of photocopies, so carrying extra copies is safer): Proof of date of birth - SSLC/Matriculation certificate All educational certificates and mark sheets from class X onwards Valid registration certificate issued by MCI, National Medical Council or any State Medical Council Experience certificate (if any) Photo identity proof (Voter ID, PAN Card, Aadhaar card, Driving Licence or Passport) Address proof Caste certificate Recommendation letter from the Head of Medical, and self-certificate on voluntary retirement (ex-employees only) Two recent passport size colour photographs No TA/DA is paid for attending the walk-in interview. Information found false at any stage leads to rejection. For queries, the contact person is Shri Debariki Suresh, AGM (HR), phone 0427-2382274.

faq.question: Q1. When and where is the SAIL Salem Steel Plant GDMO walk-in interview?
faq.answer: It is on 20 November 2026 at the HRDC Building, Salem Steel Plant. Registration is from 08.00 AM to 11.00 AM and interviews run from 11.00 AM to 4.00 PM.

faq.question: Q2. Which category is the GDMO post reserved for?
faq.answer: The single GDMO post is reserved for OBC, so candidates should carry their caste certificate for document screening.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed?
faq.answer: MBBS from a University/institute recognized by MCI, with MCI/NMC/SMC registration or a valid practitioner licence and enrolment in the State or National Register.

faq.question: Q4. What is the maximum age?
faq.answer: Candidates can be up to 69 years old as on the date of advertisement, 30 October 2026.

faq.question: Q5. Is HRA paid along with the Rs. 90,000 salary?
faq.answer: No. HRA is not admissible. A 2 BHK company quarter may be given, subject to availability, on payment of rent, electricity, water and other charges.

faq.question: Q6. How long is the contract?
faq.answer: One year at first, extendable by one year at the Company's discretion, with a maximum of three years under the same contract.

faq.question: Q7. Can retired SAIL doctors apply?
faq.answer: Yes, ex-employees of SAIL and other organisations can apply if they did not leave through voluntary retirement. They need a recommendation letter from the Head of Medical of their plant or unit and a self-certificate on this point.

faq.question: Q8. Is private practice allowed?
faq.answer: Yes, provided it does not disrupt the working hours assigned to the doctor, which are at least 8 hours a day, six days a week.

faq.question: Q9. Will travel expenses be paid for attending the interview?
faq.answer: No. The notice states that no TA/DA will be paid for attending the walk-in interview or selection process.
